ELITE: NEXT for PSP
===================

Play this build on a real PSP or in PPSSPP.

Install (PSP)
  Copy this entire ELITE-NEXT-PSP folder to:
    ms0:/PSP/GAME/ELITE-NEXT/

Install (PPSSPP)
  Open EBOOT.PBP from this folder in PPSSPP.
  A 480x272 (or integer-scaled) window keeps the UI sharp.

Custom music
  Put MP3 files into the matching folder under music/.
  The game scans the folders at startup and shuffles the
  selected station. Restart after adding or removing tracks.

  Do not rename the five station folders:
    Deep Field, Neon Transit, Pixel Comet,
    Velvet Orbit, Far Horizons

Downloads & updates
  https://github.com/roodmilk/elite-next-psp/releases/latest
